items: 【🏠5-in-1Multifunctional Clothes Rack】This bedroom dresser features spacious wooden desktop + 3 large drawers + 1 long dresser/coat hanging rod + 3 storage open shelves + side hooks. The 3 large drawers accommodate bulky clothing. The valet rack has a bearing capacity of 33lbs and supports left/right reversible installation—you may choose to install it on the left or right side according to your habits. The side hooks can be used for hanging bags. The base storage shelf offers 3-position height adjustment, flexibly housing garments, storage bins, and footwear.

【🏠Charming LED Dresser with charging station】60000 color rhythm, define your space mood with one click, easily adjust the light intensity and speed level via remote control or APP. It flexibly adapts to various scenes such as living room, esports room, and the lighting can be synchronized with music to provide a personalized atmosphere for movie nights, games, and family gatherings!

【✨ With Power Outlets】Say goodbye to messy wires! This clothes dresser is equipped with 2 AC sockets +2 USB ports, 1.5m flexible cable length, hair dryer mobile phone can be done, instant increase desktop cleanliness by 40%, through UL/ETL certification, electricity safety!

【✨ Durable Quality Material】The drawer of this 3 drawer dresser surface is composed of three layers of high-quality fiberboard and breathable non-woven fabric, the woodtop is made of P2 grade artificial wood, scratch resistant and easy to clean, the material process and safety are strictly tested by EPA&SGS, health and environmental protection, excellent quality for you and your family to create a peaceful life!

【✨ Stable Structure Safety Assured】Our storage tower is designed with 15mm thickened metal steel frame with cross support rods for durability, bearing 66lbs is still stable. The chest of drawers equipped with anti-tilt device, which can easily fix the cabinet to the wall, ensuring the safety of you, your family and pets, and enjoying a convenient life!

【✨ Premium Details】The fabric dresser is equipped with a smooth slide track and curved handles to ensure that every push and pull is easy and smooth. 6 adjustable & Lockable wheels, perfectly adapted to all kinds of ground, protecting the floor from scratches, whether it is daily adjustment position or cleaning movement, it can be easily dealt with, saving time and effort!

【📮Easy Assembly & Excellent Service】Provide detailed assembly guide, screw parts clearly marked, reserved holes and tools, quick assembly within an hour. Our Dressers is packed in a sturdy package with thick foam and wooden sheeting to prevent damage in transit. Professional after-sales team is ready to use more worry-free!
